notes: Wingman can now navigate a device web page by clicking its real menu (for example "Assurance" then "Health"), instead of guessing a URL that returns a 404 — and it stays in the browser instead of jumping to a terminal view. Ask it to take you to a page and it clicks its way there, then tells you where it actually landed.

Wingman is now held to a "verify before you confirm" rule: it won't say you're logged in or on a page unless it has actually checked, and it calls out a 404 / error honestly instead of pretending it worked.
